correctness.rationale: For the 35 vertices consisting of triples of [7], a face is a pairwise-intersecting family, i.e. Ind(KG(3,1)). The S7 action partitions the triples into cycles. Discard each orbit with an internal disjoint pair; build the incompatibility graph of remaining cycles. Each fixed simplex corresponds to an independent orbit-set, so reduced Hopf trace is -I(F_g;-1), with no missing empty-face sign. Feng (2026) supplies rational homology only in H6 rank29 and H9 rank7; seven six-subset cross-polytopal cycles supply the top signed seven-point permutation module (Feng–Wang). Thus chi6(g) = chi9(g) - I(F_g;-1). Independent reconstruction of all 15 conjugacy-class orbit graphs gave every stated trace, including chi6(identity)=29 and chi9(identity)=7; the resulting character equals S^(7)+S^(4,3)+S^(2,2,2,1). S7 rational transfer gives one invariant H6 line and no invariant H9 line, so the quotient is a rational homology S6, not proved homotopy S6. The externally published ranks remain premises, not independently derived by these finite checks.
